Committee on private universities
*101. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of private universities
established under various State legislations
and whether they have acquired the status
of research universities;
(b) whether Government have received
any suggestion from the University Grants
Commission for constituting a high level
committee to look into the fee and course
structure of private universities; and
(c) whether Government intend to set
up some new central universities, including
some world class campuses, and if so, the
number of such universities?
Ongoing power projects
*102. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of ongoing power projects
in the country and the progress made, so
far, State-wise;
(b) the amount spent on those projects
during the last three years, State-wise;
and
(c) by when those projects are likely to
be completed?
Private investment in education
*103. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal from
any source, including the Planning
Commission, to set up a policy frame-work
for facilitating private investment in
education;
(b) if so, the details and the present
status thereof;
(c) whether there is any proposal/plan
to tap sources of finance, other than the
Central Government and State Government
funds, to set up new institutions and to
expand the existing institutions in education,
especially higher education;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the number of universities, Central
Universities, deemed institutions as on
date, State-wise and category-wise?

34
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Uniform education system
†*104. SHRI SHATRUGHAN
SINHA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government agree with
Bihar Government's scheme to implement
a uniform education system;
(b) if so, whether Government intend
to provide necessary funds to the State
Government for implementing the said
scheme;
(c) whether any proposal has been
received from the State Government in this
regard; and
(d) if so, Government's policy in this
regard?
De-limitation of constituencies
*105. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the De-limitation
Commission has completed the task of
delimiting Assembly and Parliamentary
constituencies in the country;
(b) if not, the States in which the de-
limitation has been completed;
(c) the States where the de-limitation
process is continuing at various stages;
(d) by which date the Commission is
expected to submit its report;
(e) whether Government are rethinking
on de-limitation and whether the process
is likely to be started de novo;
(f) whether population criteria adopted
by the Commission has been found to be
counterproductive and undesirable; and
(g) if so, the details thereof?
Share of Punjab in education cess
*106. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the Central assistance, out of the
educational cess, given to Punjab during
2005-06, 2006-07 and that earmarked for
2007-08, for various educational schemes,
scheme-wise and year-wise; and
(b) whether the state was given its share
so as to fully utilize the central assistance,
if so, the details thereof and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Fast Track Courts for pending cases
*107. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of cases pending in
the courts in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether Government propose to
start new Fast Track Courts for the
clearance of pending cases; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Hiring of women and infants for
begging
*108. DR. P.C. ALEXANDER: Will the
Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a massive
increase in the practice of hiring the services
of women and infants by beggar mafia for
begging at public places in big cities of the
country, particularly in Delhi; and

Government to prevent the exploitation of
women and children by the beggar mafia?

minorities

Total number of questions — 155

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Research studies on global warming
744. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRA-
IAH: Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the research institutes under
the Ministry are working in a coordinated
manner to resolve issues pertaining to global
warming, that are either directly or
indirectly affecting the socio-economic
growth of the country;
(b) if so, whether research studies are
done on melting down of Himalayan
Glaciers, increased occurrence of cyclones,
particularly in Andhra Pradesh, flash floods,
cloud bursts, etc.;
(c) if so, the details thereof, alongwith
the breakthroughs made, if any; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Setting up of food parks in
Uttarakhand
†745. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal for
setting up of food parks in Uttarakhand
during 2007-08;
(b) if so, whether the locations have
been earmarked for this purpose;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the steps Government
propose to do away with the delays in this
regard?
Monitoring on meat and meat
products
746. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal before
Government for overseeing or monitoring
the meat and meat products;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is also a proposal to
set up the National Meat Board;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the Board would oversee
the growth and promote meat and poultry
sector in the country; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?

174
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Indo-France joint panel for food
processing sector
†747. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether an Indo-France joint panel
has been formed for the cooperation in the
food processing sector;
(b) if so, whether the technology for
agro products to be included under the food
processing, would also be transferred; and
(c) the food stuffs which would be
covered under the food processing sector
between India and France?
Public sector food processing industry
for Nagpur
748. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Nagpur is
the biggest producer of good quality
oranges and has great potential for food
processing industry;
(b) if so, whether any food processing
industry has been set up there in the public
sector;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Capacity of food processing and cold
storages
749. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to enhance the
capacity of food processing and cold
storages in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the total extent of loss suffered due
to poor storage facilities during the last three
years;
(d) the total amount allocated to
improve the storage facilities during that
period, State-wise; and
(e) the extent of increase registered in
the capacity of cold storages by each State?
Fee hike in higher education
750. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal from
any source, including the Planning
Commission during 2007, to increase fees
to meet at least 20 per cent of recurring
cost on higher education;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
present status of the above proposal;
(c) the details of ratio of existing fees
and recurring cost on higher education in
Central Universities, University-wise and
category-wise as on date;
(d) whether steps would be taken to
control fee structure of professional courses
in various private and other institutions
affiliated to various universities and deemed
universities;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Assistance for elementary education
in Orissa
